title: Jack the Giant Killer
author: Percival Leigh
description: "Jack the Giant Killer" by Percival Leigh is a narrative poem published in the mid-19th century.
longDescription: This whimsical tale belongs to the genre of children's literature and adventure stories, recounting the heroic exploits of a young lad named Jack as he confronts and defeats various giants and monsters.

authorInfo.bio: Percival Leigh (1813–1889) wrote Jack the Giant Killer. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
